222 valid staff respondents

no-patient / individual / group questions

expression, unit, interval, and option slots

Manual SQL annotation
4 graduate students · 5 months · revisions
one labeler + per-database reviewer

Map MIMIC-III and eICU schemas

share slots with question / time templates

current time 2105-12-31 · shuffle patient values

operation value → time template → condition value

human paraphrases (mean 21) + T5 / back-translation
RoBERTa meaning filter + perplexity / edit dedup

Three-group crowd quality gate
retain only unanimous-pass paraphrases

EHRSQL dataset

Template-covered splits per database
